basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The EE department of the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is hiring one Project Associate I (Media Relations & Communication) for the project "Silicon and Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing Research and Training Hub (SAMARTH)". The temporary post pays a consolidated INR 45,000 – 80,000 per month including HRA, for one year initially. Eligibility is a listed degree or professional qualification in an appropriate discipline, or a listed bachelor's-level qualification with 04 years of experience. Apply through the application link by 12 December 2026.

qualification.details: Experience in science communication or communications for academic, research or government organizations Experience in media relations, including drafting press releases and coordinating with journalists Proficiency in graphic design and video editing tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) Familiarity with social media analytics and paid campaign management Experience organizing outreach events, webinars and exhibitions Interest in or understanding of the semiconductor and deep-technology sector Working knowledge of Gujarati and Hindi for regional outreach Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team | The notice does not mention an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

selection_process: The notice states that merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment
and that a higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves the right not to call an applicant for a selection test
or not to fill the position through this round of selection
without assigning any reason. The notice does not describe the stages of selection.
how_to_apply: Applications are to be made through the application link given in the notice, http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/, by 12 December 2026. The notice does not describe the form-filling steps or name any documents to attach.
The notice gives the contact as the Principal Investigator: Nihar Ranjan Mohapatra, Professor, EE, [email protected].
important_instructions: The position is temporary and is linked to the SAMARTH project. Meeting the minimum eligibility does not guarantee shortlisting or appointment; a higher cutoff level may be used. The extension beyond one year depends on satisfactory performance, up to the project completion date. The pay range includes HRA, and the final amount depends on qualification and experience.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice follows Institute norms for eligibility (Funding Agency norms are not ticked). The essential qualification has two routes. For both routes, the notice requires minimum 60% marks or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in Class 10 and Class 12. Experience in science communication or communications for academic, research or government organizations Experience in media relations, including drafting press releases and coordinating with journalists Proficiency in graphic design and video editing tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) Familiarity with social media analytics and paid campaign management Experience organizing outreach events, webinars and exhibitions Interest in or understanding of the semiconductor and deep-technology sector Working knowledge of Gujarati and Hindi for regional outreach Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team The notice does not mention an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

B.C.A./B.Sc./B.A./B.Com./B.B.A./LLB. or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline with a minimum of 04 years of post-qualification experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration including HRA is INR 45,000 – 80,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The notice lists House Rent Allowance per month (if applicable) as NIL. The position is temporary. The appointment is for one year initially and is extendable on satisfactory performance up to the project completion date.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Develop and execute the social media strategy and content calendar for the hub across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Instagram, YouTube and Facebook. Create, schedule and publish engaging posts, graphics and short videos highlighting the hub's programs, research and achievements. Monitor engagement, respond to queries and grow the hub's online community. Draft press releases, media notes and articles; coordinate with print, digital and broadcast media for coverage of the hub's milestones and events. Build and maintain relationships with journalists and media houses; maintain an archive of media coverage. Plan and execute outreach campaigns to industry, academic institutions and students to enhance the hub's visibility. Coordinate with partner institutions, government agencies and industry for joint outreach activities. Organize and publicize workshops, webinars, exhibitions and institutional visits, including pre-event promotion and post-event coverage. Manage photography, videography and live coverage of events at the hub. Produce newsletters, brochures, annual highlights and success stories, coordinate website content updates with the IT team. Ensure consistent branding and messaging across all communication channels in line with institute guidelines. Track and report social media and outreach metrics using analytics tools; recommend improvements based on data. Maintain documentation of campaigns, media coverage and outreach activities. Support the hub's leadership with communication material for presentations, reports and reviews.
